race.title: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap
race.verdict: MELODICAL showed improved form when getting up late over this C&D last month and she can go on to score again now that she's up and running. Next on the list is Aurelune who has placed on her last 3 starts and now gets an eye-catching jockey booking, ahead of Upsomdowns . MELODICAL AURELUNE (IRE) UPSOMDOWNS
